text:
I came to see Dr. Pui on October 22, 2025, after a friend who had been treated there and recovered, recommended her. I came to ask Dr. Pui for treatment of pain in my upper arm. It prevented me from lying face down and placing my hand on top of my arm, and reaching to the side or behind me caused sharp pain. I had to stop yoga for over a year. An MRI revealed a partial tendon tear. I had been receiving injections, medication, and shockwave therapy for over a year at several places, but the pain only subsided without a complete cure. After one acupuncture session with Dr. Pui, I felt my arm strength improve. Dr. Pui also prescribed physical exercises in the morning and before bed. After 3-5 acupuncture sessions, the pain disappeared completely and hasn't returned. I also discussed with Dr. Pui about a kidney cyst that I've had for almost 10 years. The cyst is 2-4 cm in size. In mid-2025, I had a severe infection with a high fever and had to be hospitalized for the first time in my life. Dr. Pui advised that if I continued to get infections due to the kidney cyst, it would be necessary to remove the kidney because the cyst is large, located in the center like the yolk of an egg, and there's no cure. I was very stressed and afraid of further infections and the need for removal. Dr. Pui suggested I try acupuncture and Chinese medicine, along with dietary control and stress reduction from work. The doctor confidently explained the treatment plan, giving the patient a great deal of hope and peace of mind. I received acupuncture treatments continuously from the end of October 2025 until now, April 2026, completing 20 sessions, including the initial sessions which caused shoulder and arm pain. I also took self-prepared Chinese herbal medicine for about 50 days, stopping in early March 2026 and remaining with acupuncture until mid-April 2026. The doctor then suggested a follow-up ultrasound to check the size of the cyst. The doctor who performed the previous ultrasound during my hospitalization was puzzled, asking where the cyst had gone, which side it was on, and why it was gone. They asked what I had done. I was so happy and accidentally mentioned that I had been receiving acupuncture (I didn't intend to tell them). Upon receiving the results, I immediately sent them to Dr. Pui, overjoyed and amazed by this Traditional Chinese Medicine treatment.

I would like to express my deepest gratitude to Dr. Pui for providing a more comfortable alternative to waiting for infection and kidney removal. I wish Dr. Pui continued good health.

I hope this shared information will be useful to others. May everyone find the best health options for themselves as well.
